chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar quoted Yaqoob ibn Yazid, on the authority of Ibn Abi Umayr, on the authority of Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, on the authority of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The medical treatment is four: cupping, inhaling snuff, inserting a suppository, and making an injection.
ai.seo_question: What are the four types of medical treatment mentioned in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this hadith enumerates the four classical prophetic medical interventions—cupping, snuff, enema, and vomiting—highlighting the integration of practical health measures with spiritual tradition. It reflects the Shia emphasis on utilizing natural remedies as part of a holistic approach to well-being, often cited in discussions of *tibb al-nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine).
